subject.title: Execute media and Talk QA scenarios through runtime boundaries

question: Should maintainers accept https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/101091 as the implementation for this maintainer-labeled QA runtime-boundary issue?
rationale: The issue is maintainer-labeled and already has an open closing PR touching multiple runtime boundaries, so cleanup automation should not close or replace that decision.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Use the open PR as the active implementation path if its runtime-boundary changes and proof satisfy maintainers.

options.title: Request revisions on the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open and ask for narrower changes or extra proof before merging the PR.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
